canonicalization: SHA-256 of json.dumps(parsedJSON, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8').
enforcement: The checker independently pins the literal canonical hash; this descriptive file, document pins and trust files cannot override it.
policy: Do not weaken criteria to obtain a pass. Altered criteria require a separately governed framework release.
authorityBoundary: Local file integrity does not authenticate reviewers, source truth, organizational approval, readiness or delivery.
